    """A marker added dynamically from within the test function must be honored."""
    testdir.makepyfile(
        """
        import pytest

        def test_xfail(request):
            request.node.add_marker(pytest.mark.xfail(reason="xfail"))
            assert 0
        """

    result.stdout.fnmatch_lines(["*1 xfailed*"])

            request.node.add_marker(pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="xfail"))
        """

    result = testdir.runpytest()
    result.stdout.fnmatch_lines(["*XPASS(strict)*", "*1 failed*"])
